This '''estate''', located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]], was owned by the family of [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]]. After [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] rescued [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Dowmeia invited Skywalker to visit the estate.
